opening_message:
Ticket 1: Nancy Hunter (employee ID E038) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E038.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Nancy Hunter (E038) is a contractor Engineer. Contractors are never granted admin. Requested admin to Payroll exceeds the maximum; recommend granting at most read (write only if advanced security training, per Security agent).
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Nancy Hunter (E038) is a contractor Engineer with basic security training. Contractors with basic training are limited to read; write requires advanced training, and admin is never granted. Requested admin to Payroll exceeds the maximum; recommend granting read.
reason: Nancy Hunter (E038) is a contractor Engineer with basic security training. Per policy, contractors are never granted admin; they may have read, or write only with advanced security training. Since she has basic training, her maximum access to Payroll is read. The requested admin exceeds this maximum, so grant read.
